title: Notebook modules catalog
description: Curated notebook modules shipped with the default notebooks repository.

$schema.$comment: Optional reference to this schema, for editor/tooling validation of the catalog document.

author.$comment: Attribution shown on the workflow card.

category.$comment: Semantic system category. Shown on the workflow card and mapped to its icon client-side.

repository.$comment: Optional Git repository URL. Defaults to the configured default notebooks repository when absent.

path.$comment: Repository-relative directory path. Use '.' for the repository root (full clone, preserves Binder setup files at root).
